metadata.name: 心智娘 · 菌伞轻裙（设计样板）
metadata.tips: She has turned the shape of a mushroom cap into a little dress. You ask whether it offers shelter from the rain. This is an outfit, not public colony infrastructure! she protests, guarding the hem—before pulling you under the umbrella beside her.
